title.value: Adapting Pre-trained Language Models to African Languages via Multilingual Adaptive Fine-Tuning
title.justification: The title clearly describes the main focus of the paper: adapting pre-trained language models to African languages using a multilingual adaptive fine-tuning approach.
title.quote: Adapting Pre-trained Language Models to African Languages via Multilingual Adaptive Fine-Tuning

extractions.description: This paper discusses the adaptation of pre-trained multilingual language models to African languages through a method called multilingual adaptive fine-tuning (MAFT). It aims to address the challenge of including African languages, which are often low-resourced, in pre-trained models without needing separate models for each language, thereby encouraging cross-lingual transfer learning. The approach reduces model size by removing non-African language tokens and evaluates the approach using various NLP tasks like NER, news topic classification, and sentiment analysis.
